about.title: About this memorial
body: Padre Wasson always said that his children are not orphans, because they have a family. This family stays together after the years in the homes, and it stays together when one of us dies.

On these pages we remember children and young people of Nuestros Pequeños Hermanos who have died. Each page belongs to one person. Family, brothers and sisters from the homes, godparents and volunteers can leave a few words or light a candle.

A page is only made when the family and NPH agree. Everything that is sent to us is read by someone from the foundation before it appears. Pages for children who died before turning 18 are checked once more before they are published.
We do not use cookies for tracking and we do not use analytics. If you have questions, or if you would like something changed or removed, write to us at info@padrewassonfoundation.org.

privacy.title: Privacy
body: This text is a placeholder. The foundation's privacy notice for these pages still has to be written and checked.

What the memorial does today: it stores the tributes, candles and requests that people send, together with the time they were sent. It does not store IP addresses. To stop abuse it keeps a one-way hash of the address for at most one day. It sets no cookies for visitors; staff who sign in get a session cookie. It does not use analytics or tracking.
Photos are re-saved before they are stored, which removes location and camera data.
